Bug_Title: Constructor injection should be used instead of field injection
Bug_Explanation: Constructor injection should be used instead of field injection
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by failing to inject the MyCollaborator instance through the constructor of MyComponent. When the MyCollaborator instance is null, when MyComponent is instantiated, NullPointerException is expected to be thrown.
Model_Explanation: The described bug is present in the provided Java code. The MyComponent class uses field injection, which can lead to NullPointerException if the collaborator object is not properly initialized. The constructor of MyComponent is public, which means it can be called by any class, including classes that are not managed by a Dependency Injection framework. This means that the collaborator object may not be properly initialized, leading to a NullPointerException when the myBusinessMethod method is called.
